why: A citation that resolves to a real file is still not a source: this leaves criterion.Goal.achieved.v1 pointing at 02-architecture-selection.md and changes the quoted sentence to one that is not in it. That is what a quote looks like after the passage it came from has been edited, and it is indistinguishable by eye from one that has not.
expect_failure_contains: derived_from quotes text that is not in the file it cites

patch.value: Achievement is established by the producer reporting that the work is done.
